observations: Publisher abstract explicitly refers to previously determined low toxicity of ascidiathiazone A; antibacterial MIC is not a mammalian toxicity endpoint. No claim of zero risk or safety certification.
Previous combined parallel task was content-review blocked; this record is limited to chemical identities and graph connectivity and does not reproduce biological or preparative protocols.
Source Fig1 background natural products and retrosynthetic arrows are not imported as experimentally obtained route compounds.
